headline: Saudi led coalition says it destroyed 50 Houthi military targets across Yemen
label: BREAKING
caption:
Saudi led coalition forces carried out major strikes in Yemen. 🚨

According to Anadolu, the Saudi led coalition announced that it destroyed 50 Houthi military targets across Yemen.

The operation comes amid ongoing conflict in the region.

Further details on potential casualties or specific locations have not yet been fully detailed in the initial reports.
